title: Coherent-end formula for total-site mapping complexes
statement: Let $I$ be a small poset and $i\mapsto\mathcal C_i$ a strict covariant diagram of small categories [def-weil-size-convention] with full-sieve transition inclusions $\iota_{ij}:\mathcal C_i\to\mathcal C_j$. Form $\mathcal E$ with objects $(i,T)$, $T\in\mathcal C_i$, and arrows $(i,T)\to(j,S)$ for $i\le j$ given by arrows $\iota_{ij}T\to S$ in $\mathcal C_j$. Let $\mathbf D(\Lambda)$ be the enhanced derived category of modules over a commutative ring $\Lambda$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and let $F,G:\mathcal E^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathbf D(\Lambda)$ be coherent presheaves, meaning that they carry every identity-underlying transition arrow to an equivalence with all coherent composition data. The derived mapping complex between $F$ and $G$ in this enhanced coherent-presheaf category is naturally equivalent to the homotopy-coherent end over all strings of arrows of $\mathcal E$ of the pointwise derived mapping complexes $\operatorname{Map}(F(T),G(T))$. Under the presheaf straightening equivalence, this end is the derived mapping complex between the corresponding coherent fibre systems. The equivalence is natural in $F$ and $G$ and preserves identities and composition.
